part.content: {"reply": {"text":"Thank you for contacting us. We’re sorry for the inconvenience. The flickering near the controller and the heat you’ve experienced are covered by our warranty. As a result, we are issuing a store credit of €15 to your account. Please keep the strip unplugged until the controller is inspected or replaced. If the flicker returns after checking the plug, the controller will be replaced under warranty.","citations":[{"chunk_id":"kb_strip0flck","quote":"If a Flow strip flickers near the controller, cut the power and check the controller plug. If the flicker comes back, the controller is replaced under warranty."},{"chunk_id":"kb_ctrlheat01","quote":"If the controller body is hot to the touch, unplug the strip at once and do not switch it on until it has been checked."}]}}
